l1: Never mock the database in integration tests — use a real Postgres container
Confidence percentages tend toward optimism — halve first estimate for anything involving unknown APIs
Always test migrations on a staging replica before touching prod
pgloader silently drops rows with encoding mismatches — always diff row counts after
No parallel subagents that share a mutable file — sequential only
Log every turn (the capture hooks) — never batch-log at session close
Agents report tasks; the operator moves cards
Test two saves made in the same minute
